scheme_name: Vidyasiri food And Accommodation Scholarship Scheme
other_conditions: Student must be a citizen of India
Student must be a permanent resident of Karnataka
Student must belong to backward classes listed by the Government of India or the State Government
Student must be pursuing post‑matric courses in government, local, aided, or recognized private institutions affiliated with statutory universities in Karnataka
Student must not have secured admission in any departmental or government‑funded student hostel
Student must link their Aadhaar number to their bank account
Student’s attendance must be at least 75% as verified by the college principal
benefits_summary: Monthly stipend of Rs.1,500 for 10 months (total Rs.15,000 per year) to support food and accommodation expenses.
